findings.title: wb_port.wb_adr_i is 28 bits; the spec declares 29
findings.detail: host_interface.address_width_bits = 29, so wb_port.wb_adr_i must be 29 bits wide; the design makes it 28. The host byte address spans the spec's host address space on the bus and on the request the port forwards.
